name: divine
description: Random divination: method zhouyi casts an I Ching (Zhouyi) hexagram, tarot draws tarot cards, fortune gives a luck reading, dice rolls dice. The tool only produces the random result; the interpretation is up to you.

count.description: dice only: number of dice, default 1, max 100.

sides.description: dice only: sides per die, default 6, max 1000.

modifier.description: dice only: optional modifier added to the total.
